title: Alexandria expedition of 1807
summary: The English Wikipedia article "Alexandria expedition of 1807", at revision 1372782262, opens: "The Alexandria expedition of 1807, also known as the Fraser expedition, as an unsuccessful attempt by British forces to capture the Egyptian city of Alexandria during the Anglo-Turkish War. The aim was to secure a base of operations against the Ottoman Empire and the French Empire in the Mediterranean Sea. It was part of a larger British strategy against the Franco-Ottoman alliance negotiated by Sultan Selim III." That is the article's account and not yet this atlas's; nobody has read this record, and review.html is where somebody does. Wikidata item Q2456916, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "Egyptian victory over British forces". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
